title: Plantation band changes: Ladnier, drummers, trombone and banjo
summary: He recalls Tommy Ladnier replacing Lee Collins, Barbarin and Snags on drums, George Smith for the shows, and George Filhe being replaced because his trombone intonation slipped.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
